blocks.text: Roshni ki fitrat (nature) kya hai, yeh sawal kaafi mushkil nikla. Kya roshni energy ko aik jagah se doosri jagah wave (lehar) ki shakal mein le jati hai ya particles (zarrat) ki dhaar ki shakal mein? Wave aik chalti hui disturbance (halchal) hai jo energy le ja sakti hai, aur roshni kai phenomena (mazahir) mein wave jaisa bartao dikhati hai. Doosri lehron ke muqable mein roshni ki fitrat aasani se tay nahi hoti, kyunke yeh khud ko saaf taur par zahir nahi karti. Roshni ke wave hone ka khayal sab se pehle 1678 mein Christiaan Huygens ne diya. Us waqt is ke haq mein experimental evidence (tajurbati saboot) mazboot nahi tha, is liye Newton ki 1672 wali corpuscular (zarrat wali) theory zyada mashhoor aur maqbool thi. 1801 mein Young ke interference experiment ne roshni ka wave hona sabit kiya aur yun Huygens ki wave theory qaim ho gayi. 1860 mein Maxwell ne roshni ko electromagnetic waves mana. Un ke mutabiq oscillating (jhoolte hue) electric charges badalte hue electric aur magnetic fields banate hain jo aik doosre ko dobara paida karte rehte hain aur vacuum (khala) mein bhi aage barh sakte hain. Beesvi sadi ke shuru mein quantum mechanics ne bataya ke roshni ki dual nature (dohri fitrat) hai: experiment ke mutabiq is mein wave aur particle dono ki khasiyatein nazar aati hain. Roshni electromagnetic wave ki tarah safar karti hai, lekin matter (maadde) se alag alag, massless (be-wazan) particles ki tarah milti hai jinhein photons kehte hain. Phir bhi roshni ki wave theory ab bhi durust hai aur roshni ke mazahir kamyabi se samjhati hai. Is chapter mein hum roshni ki woh khasiyatein parhenge jo us ke wave hone se judi hain, jaise interference aur diffraction.

blocks.prompt: Kis experiment ne roshni ki wave theory qaim ki, aur kab?

items: Huygens (1678): roshni wave hai; Newton (1672): roshni particles (corpuscles) hai.
Young (1801): interference ne roshni ka wave hona sabit kiya; Maxwell (1860): roshni electromagnetic waves.
Quantum mechanics: roshni ki dual nature; matter se photons ki shakal mein milti hai.
Is chapter mein: interference aur diffraction.
